_readme: Shipped seed for the ray traced surface materials. The game copies these entries into
Documents\Quest64Recompiled\Ray Tracing\rt_materials.json, adds its own guesses there, and reads it when it starts.
Entries here with source "user" replace guesses in that file; entries edited there with source "user" always win.
Keys are the texture hashes logged as 'material key' in the F9 capture.
class: matte, sprite, grass, dirt, wood, cloth, skin, stone, polished, metal or water.
roughness 0 (mirror) to 1 (matte); metalness 0 (plastic, stone) to 1 (metal); specular 0 (none) to 1 (full).
Advanced Water Rendering shades large flat surfaces with class water (blended or opaque), plus water it detects: flat, wide
alpha blended layers without depth writes, and flat, wide opaque surfaces whose texture scrolls (blue or blue-green pixels only).
For water, specular is the reflectivity (1 = full Fresnel) and roughness the sharpness of the sun glint (0.05 to 0.1).
A user entry with another class stops a texture from being treated as water.
